page_note: Page presents the systematic five-worlds-of-Darkness teaching: each king receives face/body/taste/projection. The first three slots map cosmos→cosmos (zoomorphic, metal, sensory). The projection slot consistently identifies contemporary structures — earthly rulers, fire-sacrificers (Zoroastrians), idol-temples, water-baptists — making the projection-applications a recurring polemical insertion. Substrate teaching is dense and well-preserved on body/metal/taste; editorial pointing clusters in the projection segments. Fatigue score (+17.8 ecclesial, +23.0 polemic in second half) confirms the pattern.
